definition: מִשְׂרְפוֺת מַיִם proper name, of a location names with Sidon Josh 11:8 ; Josh 13:6 (apparently near coast); compare (dubious Buhl Geogr. 229 ) Mušêrfe , 14 miles south of Tyre, see Di and references, Guérin Gal ii. 166 f. . — Μασερων , Μασρεφωθμαειμ , etc.
